verses.1: The sons of Levi were Kehat and Merari.
verses.2: And these are the names of the sons of Gerashom: Libni and Shimei.
verses.3: And the sons of Khat: Amram, Yitzhar, Heveron, and Uziel.
verses.4: The sons of Merari were Nahash, Mushi, and these are the descendants of Levi to their ancestors.
verses.5: Let our children be like him; let them be his descendants.
verses.6: Yohah beno, he is our savior. Yatray beno, he is our strength.
verses.7: The children of Khat are the people of Nadab. Korach is one of their descendants. Asir is also one of their descendants.
verses.8: Elekana is our son, and Avysaf is also our son. As for Asir, he’s our son as well.
verses.9: Under their leadership were Uriel, Uziah, and Shaul.
verses.10: And the sons of Elkanah: Amashai and Ahimoth.
verses.11: Elkanah, sons of Elkanah; Zophai, his son; and Nahash, his son.
verses.12: Eliezer son of Joram, Elkanah son of Eliezer.
verses.13: And the sons of Semuel: Bekhor and Shnay. And Aviyah.
verses.14: The sons of Merari shall be my children; Shemi shall be my son. Uzah shall be my son as well.
verses.15: Hear our son, Hagiya; our son, Asya.
verses.16: And these are those whom David stood up against the people of the house of God, from the throne.
verses.17: And they served before the tent of the Assembly, singing songs. They worked hard to build the House of God in Jerusalem. They stood there, according to their duties.
verses.18: And these are the ones who stand there; and among them are the descendants of the Kohathites from the last generation. They were descendants of Jealous, son of Shimeah.
verses.19: Ben-Elkanah, son of Yeroham, son of Eliel, son of Tohach.
verses.20: Son of Zuf, son of Elkanah, son of Mahath, son of Amashai.
verses.21: Ben-Elkanah, son of Yoel, son of Azarya, son of Tzfanya.
verses.22: Son of a prisoner, son of Aviyasaf, son of Korach.
verses.23: The son of Jethro, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, the son of Israel.
verses.24: And his brothers stood on his right side. They were Asaf, son of Berechiah, and Zimchi’ah.
verses.25: Benjamin Mikhael, son of Ba’shiyah, son of Malchiyah.
verses.26: Son of Etni, son of Zerah, son of Adaya.
verses.27: Son of Ethan, son of Zimmah, son of Shimei.
verses.28: Son of Jachth, son of Gershom, son of Levi.
verses.29: And the sons of Merari were Ahieh, on Mount Sinai. Etan son of Kishyi, son of Abdi, son of Malchut.
verses.30: Son of Chashbayah, son of Amasya, son of Khilkiyah.
verses.31: Son of Amzic, son of Beni, son of Shamer.
verses.32: Son of Makhli, son of Mushi, son of Merari, son of Levi.
verses.33: And the Levites were assigned to perform all the duties related to the service in the Temple of God.
verses.34: And Aaron and his sons offer sacrifices on the altar of the LORD, as well as on the altar of the incense. They also offer sacrifices for all the sacred offerings. They also bear witness against Israel, just as Moses, the servant of the LORD, commanded them to do.
verses.35: And these are the sons of Aaron: Elazar, Pinchas, Abihu.
verses.36: Buki beno, Uzi beno, Zerahya beno.
verses.37: Meriot, son of Amariah; son of Ahitub.
verses.38: Zadok son of Ahimelech, son of Boaz.
verses.39: And these are the places where they lived in their cities, on their borders, among the descendants of Aaron, for they were the people who had the guards.
verses.40: And they were given their land in the land of Judah, along with its surrounding areas.
verses.41: And the fields of the city and its courtyards were given to Caleb, son of Jephunneh.
verses.42: And to the cities of Bethlehem, they were given: their suburbs, and Bethlehem itself, along with its suburbs. Also, Jeter, and Eshetma’a, along with their suburbs.
verses.43: And Hiz and Migrashia, Dvir and Migrashia as well.
verses.44: And its smoke, and its ashes, and the house of Shemesh, and its ashes as well.
verses.45: And from the heights of Binniam, they took possession of its slopes and its valleys. They also took possession of its towns and their surroundings. There were thirteen cities in total, all belonging to them.
verses.46: And the children of Khatt, who were freed from the family of Metah. Half of them were men, and ten of them were women.
verses.47: And the towns of Gershom were given to their families from the region of Issachar, and from the region of Asher, and from the region of Naphtali. There were thirteen such towns in total.
verses.48: To the families of Merari, from the place of Reuben, and from the place of Gad, and from the place of Zebulun, in the territory of two hundred cities.
verses.49: And the sons of Israel gave to the Levites the cities and their suburbs.
verses.50: And they gave these cities to the people of Judah, to the people of Shem, and to the people of Benjamin. These are the cities whose names are mentioned in the Bible.
verses.51: And from the families of Kenan, there were cities in their borders, starting from Efrém.
verses.52: And they gave them the cities of the Plain, along with their suburbs. They also gave them Mount Ebal, along with its suburbs. And they gave them Gezer, along with its suburbs.
verses.53: And their fields, and their vineyards, and the house of Horon, and their fields as well.
verses.54: And Eyalon, and its slopes, and Gath Rimmon, and its slopes as well.
verses.55: And from half of Manasseh’s territory, he took Gilead and its towns, and also Bilhah and its towns, for the family of Reuben, who were still living there.
verses.56: I took the land from the family of Hatsibmah Mneshah: her fields, her paths, and all its surrounding areas.
verses.57: And from the mountain of Issachar, he took the holy place and its surroundings. He also took its surroundings with him.
verses.58: And its branches, and its leaves, and its roots, and its branches.
verses.59: And from the top of the hill, along with its slopes and its surroundings, as well as its servants and their surroundings.
verses.60: And its walls, and its foundations, and its breadth, and its foundations as well.
verses.61: And from the top of Naphthali, I will take the sacred objects, along with their containers and containers for storing them. I will also take my utensils and their containers.
verses.62: The branches of the fig tree that have broken off from its trunk, along with its leaves and branches.
verses.63: And from there, the wind blows towards Jordan. From the side of Reuben, one can see Bezer in the desert, as well as its surrounding areas, and Yahtza and its surroundings.
verses.64: And its predecessors, and its descendants, and its offspring.
verses.65: And from the edge of the field, they destroyed its crops, as well as its pastures and camps.
verses.66: And her thoughts, and her plans, and her actions, and her intentions.
